series.notes: Independent original audit. Resource gates are historical rules, not current-hardware capability.

timing: Original single-call event boundaries and independent-process launches retained; host capture adds raw events. This is not same-context unified benchmarking. Each implementation uses the default stream within its own process. Actual input fingerprints are checked across processes. events7 uses 7 rounds x 30 events and 10 warmups. historical-counts only selects archived repeat counts: changed group composition, one-size input allocation, smoke order, and absence of the archived 4096 thermal prelude prevent an exact historical replay claim. Main unified comparisons need a separate harness.
scope: one series/one shape/one beta; smoke separate; all files closed before BATCH_CLOSED
